Pre-processing (same as practice activity 8.1): 
```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder, PolynomialFeatures
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression, Ridge, Lasso, ElasticNet, LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score, confusion_matrix, accuracy_score, precision_recall_fscore_support, roc_auc_score
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.compose import make_column_selector, ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score
from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from palmerpenguins import load_penguins
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsRegressor, KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeRegressor, DecisionTreeClassifier

```

```{python}
penguins=load_penguins()
penguins2=load_penguins()
penguins=penguins.dropna()
penguins2=penguins2.dropna()
```

```{python}
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
```


```{python}
penguins2["is_gentoo"]=(penguins2["species"]=="Gentoo").astype(int)
```

```{python}
ct_dummify = ColumnTransformer(
  [
    ("dummify", 
    OneHotEncoder(sparse_output = False, handle_unknown='ignore'), ["sex", "island"]), 
    ("select", 
    StandardScaler(), 
    make_column_selector(dtype_include=np.number))
  ],
  remainder = "drop").set_output(transform = "pandas")
```

```{python}
y=penguins["species"]
y2=penguins2["is_gentoo"]
X=penguins.drop(columns="bill_depth_mm")
X2=penguins2.drop(columns=["is_gentoo", "species"])
```

```{python}
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, stratify=y)
X2_train, X2_test, y2_train, y2_test = train_test_split(X2, y2, test_size=0.25, stratify=y2)
```

## Models on Entire Dataset

### Logistic Regression 
```{python}
logistic_regression_pipeline=Pipeline(
    [("preprocessing", ct_dummify), 
    ("logistic regression", LogisticRegression())]
)
logistic_regression_pipeline.fit(X2,y2)
```


### kNN 
```{python}
kNN_pipeline_1=Pipeline(
    [("preprocessing", ct_dummify), 
    ("logistic regression", KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=10))]
)
kNN_pipeline_1.fit(X,y)
```

```{python}
kNN_pipeline_2=Pipeline(
    [("preprocessing", ct_dummify), 
    ("logistic regression", KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=5))]
)
kNN_pipeline_2.fit(X,y)
```

### Decision trees
```{python}
tree_pipeline_1=Pipeline(
    [("preprocessing", ct_dummify), 
    ("logistic regression", DecisionTreeClassifier(ccp_alpha=0.2))]
)
tree_pipeline_1.fit(X,y)
```

```{python}
tree_pipeline_2=Pipeline(
    [("preprocessing", ct_dummify), 
    ("logistic regression", DecisionTreeClassifier(ccp_alpha=0.5))]
)
tree_pipeline_2.fit(X,y)
```

## Models on the Training Data Only

### Logistic Regression 
```{python}
logistic_regression_pipeline=Pipeline(
    [("preprocessing", ct_dummify), 
    ("logistic regression", LogisticRegression())]
)
logistic_regression_pipeline.fit(X2_train,y2_train)
```

```{python}
y2_pred = logistic_regression_pipeline.predict(X2_test)
print("LogReg accuracy:", accuracy_score(y2_test, y2_pred))
print("Confusion matrix:\n", confusion_matrix(y2_test, y2_pred))
```

Overall accuracy is 1 



### kNN 
```{python}
kNN_pipeline_1=Pipeline(
    [("preprocessing", ct_dummify), 
    ("logistic regression", KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=10))]
)
kNN_pipeline_1.fit(X_train,y_train)
```

```{python}
y_pred = kNN_pipeline_1.predict(X_test)
overall_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)
cm = confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred)
print(cm)
print(overall_accuracy)
```


```{python}
kNN_pipeline_2=Pipeline(
    [("preprocessing", ct_dummify), 
    ("logistic regression", KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=5))]
)
kNN_pipeline_2.fit(X_train,y_train)
```

```{python}
y_pred = kNN_pipeline_2.predict(X_test)
y_pred_proba = kNN_pipeline_2.predict_proba(X_test)
overall_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)
cm = confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred)
print(overall_accuracy)
print(cm)
```

Accuracy is 0.9880952380952381. 

## Decision trees
```{python}

)
tree_pipeline_1.fit(X_train,y_train)
```


Accuracy is 0.9285714285714286.
